title: Government Raises Onion Price Stabilisation Buffer Procurement Price by 13% to ₹2,125/Quintal
summary: Revises onion procurement price upwards for the 5th time this season via NAFED and NCCF.

blocks.title: 📰 1. 💰 ESI, FINANCE & BUSINESS NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Government Raises Onion Price Stabilisation Buffer Procurement Price by 13% to ₹2,125/Quintal. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Revises onion procurement price upwards for the 5th time this season via NAFED and NCCF.
Price Revision: Procurement price raised from ₹1,875 to ₹2,125 per quintal (w.e.f.
Procurement Agencies: Procured through NAFED and National Cooperative Consumers' Federation (NCCF).
Production Estimate: 2025-26 onion production estimated at 307.37 lakh metric tonnes (LMT).
Revised procurement price (₹2,125/quintal) vs earlier price (₹1,875/quintal).
